description: This Java class `GoodreadsBookImport` represents a data model for importing book details from Goodreads, including fields like title, author, rating, date read, and bookshelves. It also contains a static method to map shelf names to predefined shelf enums.

classes.name: GoodreadsBookImport
classes.description: A data class for importing Goodreads book data with properties for title, author, rating, date read, and bookshelves, with support for JSON serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: toPredefinedShelfName
methods.description: Converts a shelf name string into an Optional enum value of type PredefinedShelf.ShelfName, handling blanks and unrecognized names.
